n: SWGfL AI for Key Stage Two
t: A 5 page lesson plan that teaches how machine learning works and where it fails.
steps: Find the plan and slide deck on the SWGfL site.
Print the duck images if you want paper cards.
Prepare tablets or laptops with internet access.
Try Google Teachable Machine yourself first.
Ask IT whether Teachable Machine is allowed.
Decide how pupils will use cameras or image files.
